policy.temporal_contract: observation t predicts source command t+1

visual_probe.coordinate_frame: RoboTwin simulator world coordinates in metres; fixed robot base transform saved during collection. Object actor origin and robot right EE reference, not contact-tip pose.
visual_probe.inputs: Frozen Omega512 RGB patch features only; no state, actions, instruction, episode/frame/time IDs, or GT cameras.
visual_probe.label_alignment: Synchronized regenerated simulator RGB/poses on the fixed source scene seeds. Initial RGB/state/model identity checked against originals. Original later-frame labels are not substituted.
visual_probe.frame_selection_rule: Five evenly spaced frames in each regenerated gripper-command phase: approach, grasp (first eight closed frames), transport, release. No feature/prediction information used to select frames.

launch_history.outcome: Failed initial scene RGB check at episode 70; see probe_failure_diagnostic.json

budget_amendment: Experiment 2 specifies 40 trajectories, 24/8/8 train/validation/test, 20 phase-stratified frames each, 300-epoch ceiling with validation-only early stopping at patience 40. Registered before fitting.
note: Experiment 1 and 2 are fitting and localization, not dense-versus-query policy ablations.
